data.display_address: One Za'abeel The Residences, Zabeel 1, Zabeel, Dubai
data.long_description:
Step into this sophisticated 2-bedroom duplex apartment in One Za’abeel, where contemporary design meets exceptional comfort. The expansive open-plan living area is enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows, flooding the space with natural light and offering breathtaking panoramic views.

The sleek, modern kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances, making it both functional and stylish. Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed to ensure privacy and comfort, complete with built-in wardrobes. The apartment also features two elegantly designed bathrooms, a guest powder room, and a private balcony—perfect for relaxing and enjoying the stunning surroundings.

Located in Za’abeel 1, Bur Dubai, One Za’abeel is an iconic multi-building development that seamlessly blends luxury with innovation. This architectural landmark is home to ultra-luxury hotels, premium office spaces, high-end retail outlets, and exclusive residences. Its striking glass façade, complemented by external fins, creates a shimmering presence within Dubai’s skyline.
